import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the dataset
sleep_health = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

sleep_health['BMI Category'] = sleep_health['BMI Category'].astype('category')
sleep_health['Blood Pressure'] = sleep_health['Blood Pressure'].astype('category')
sleep_health['Sleep Disorder'] = sleep_health['Sleep Disorder'].astype('category')

# Create a bar chart for the distribution of sleep disorders
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='Sleep Disorder', data=sleep_health, order=sleep_health['Sleep Disorder'].value_counts().index)

plt.legend(title='Sleep Disorder')
plt.tight_layout()

plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration')
plt.ylabel('Physical Activity Level')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, overwrite=True)
